task_description: Apply the 'One Filled Thing' style guide to the entire PartySwoop app. Complete visual overhaul replacing all rounded corners, colored fills, shadows, emoji, tinted panels, and colored badges with a minimal ruled-row system. Only one element per screen gets a color fill (the active/new request). Everything else uses ink, 1px rules, and space.

verification.summary: Build succeeds (all routes compile). All 53 tests pass. No emoji in source files. No rounded-xl/lg/2xl, no shadows, no colored fills (bg-blue/green/yellow/red/purple/gray-50). Only rounded-full used for 6px state dots (allowed by style guide). Only animation is spinner with motion-reduce:animate-none.
